title: HowToLiveBetter Flashcards
description: One faithful card per numbered upstream book entry. Advice, limitations and references are retained from the CC BY 4.0 source.

question.description: The original short advice title serves as the front of the flashcard.

answer.description: Original plain-language explanation, with Markdown formatting removed.

note.description: Complete original limitations, circumstances, disagreements and caveats. This should remain accessible beside the answer.

benefit.description: Complete original evidence/benefit explanation; numerical context is preserved.

evidence.description: The upstream author's grade; it is not a new independent assessment.

sourceReferences.description: Complete original bibliography, including quoted laws and source limitations. Experience-only entries have no external source URL.

sourceUrl.description: Immutable GitHub commit link, with the exact original entry's line range.
